profile.headline: Software Engineer, Principal at CACI International Inc
profile.summary:
Software Engineer/Computer Analyst with 21 years of research, cryptography and software engineering experience. Experience in creation, mathematical and statistical model development, program and report writing and making presentations.  Adept at recognizing potential problems, creating and developing alternatives, and presenting simplified solutions.  Effective team leader with demonstrated ability to manage special projects.

Specialties: Mathematics, Cryptology, Algorithm Development, Modeling and Simulation

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote software to track military units in the field
Evaluated intelligence software for Army in C++ and C# programming
Implemented geolocation algorithms for intelligence software
Conducted integration test of company software and resolved defects

positions.title: Principal Computer Analyst
positions.description:
Worked on missile defense training software for Boeing. 
Wrote Java code to implement new post processing analysis tools for Joint Threat Engagement and Analysis Model (JTEAM).
Integrated several Composite Hardbody and Missile Plume (CHAMP) models from Joint Modeling and Simulation Software (JMASS) into JTEAM and tested new Electro-Optical/ Infrared (EO/IR) threats in JTEAM.
Supported JTEAM and JMASS for 453rd Electronic Warfare Squadron at Lackland Air Force Base.
Implemented the automatic creation of JMASS threat players from Simulink models using Real Time Workshop.
Created and implemented comprehensive test plan for entire JTEAM GUI.
Created software to display Digital Terrain Elevation Data (DTED) maps using OpenGL including 2D/3D visualization.
Applied radar concepts to aircraft modeling and simulation.
Wrote software to create and display rectangular hit-miss plots and full radial hit-miss plots from half radial hit-miss plots in JTEAM.
Consultant for the feasibility of using Lie groups to solve partial differential equations.
   Performed duties of Information Systems Security Manager.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integrated commercial secure gateway with company product.  
Wrote Command Line Interface for company product application.  
Wrote an SMTP gateway for company's software product.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Researched developments in cryptography.  
Implemented C and Java algorithms performing distributed and threshold cryptography. These algorithms were based on ideas contained in academic papers.  . 
Wrote Perl script to analyze large files of data and C code.

positions.title: Cryptologic Mathematician
positions.description:
•	Applied sophisticated mathematics to problems in signals analysis and cryptology to develop software.
•	Wrote programs in C, C++, and FORTRAN in the Unix operating system; produced documentation of work and gave oral presentations describing it.  
•	Interacted with engineers in implementations of algorithms in hardware.  
•	Managed and trained new employees in Cryptologic Mathematician Program.
•	Supervised student interns in summer co-op program.
